title: Agrarian labor strike in Ica and La Libertad beginning in November 2020
notes: The SciELO-hosted scholarly study says the Ica strike began at dawn Nov 30, La Libertad joined Dec 3, workers there resumed roadblocks Dec 30, and Jan 1 dialogue led to agreement to unblock the Panamericana Norte and closure of the strike protest cycle. Diario Correo contemporaneously says the Jan 1 meeting followed an agreement to unblock the road and was private. These sources support a November-start episode and possible transition through Jan 1, but do not establish physical gathering/continuity on Jan 1 or the exact physical end. A Jan 4 Ica Fentagri call is reported contemporaneously; the later study says most workers did not recognize it, and no opened source establishes a separate physical assembly. December deaths and police actions are outside this continuation response record and are not copied to January events.
